instruction:
With AutoCAD, open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\volume_seed.dxf. Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.

Import volume_seed.dxf. Draw a closed stepped cross-section profile through vertices (0,0), (120,0), (120,30), (90,30), (90,65), (45,65), (45,95), and (0,95). Add internal datum CENTER lines x=45 and x=90 from y=0 to y=95, and add text ACAD-35. Use OUTLINE for the stepped cross-section profile, CENTER for datum lines, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
